hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Custom-curve hook enabling 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the input from PoolManager, converting via phiEth deposit/withdraw, and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked; only ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee are accepted.
